title: Eiffel Tower Ko Har 7 Saal Mein 60 Ton Paint!
idea: Every ~7 years the Eiffel Tower gets repainted by hand. Each job uses about 60 tonnes of paint, roughly 50 painters and covers 250,000 m². It has been repainted 20 times in 136 years.

lines.text: Eiffel Tower ko har 7 saal mein naya make-up lagta hai!
Ek baar mein lagta hai 60 ton paint, lagbhag 10 haathiyon jitna!
Koi machine nahi, 50 painters brush se haath se paint karte hain!
Itna area rangna padta hai jitne 35 football ground, 2.5 lakh square meter!
136 saal mein yeh tower 20 baar repaint ho chuka hai!
Kyunki bina paint ke lohe ko jung kha jaayega! Aap kaunsa color choose karoge?

facts.claim: The Eiffel Tower has been repainted 20 times in 136 years, about once every 7 years.
Each repainting campaign uses about 60 tonnes of paint and about 50 painters, and covers 250,000 m².
Repainting needs about 1,500 brushes, and the paint is applied by hand.
Several coats of paint protect the tower's iron from oxidation (rust).
FIFA's recommended pitch is 105 m x 68 m = 7,140 m², so 250,000 m² is about 35 pitches.
Adult male African elephants weigh up to about 6 tonnes, so 60 tonnes is about 10 elephants.
